Type: distressed Persian area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area, covering a floor; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: traditional, bohemian, contemporary
Materials: low-pile woven fibers with a faded distressed finish
Colors: cool sky blue, cream, navy, sage accents
Shape: rectangle, repeating lattice of medallion motifs, faded worn-look edges, slim border, low pile, medium visual weight
Feel: calm, fresh, vintage, relaxed
Goes with: dark wood floors, cognac leather, white walls; coastal, bohemian or transitional rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Distressed Persian Area Rug, 5 x 8 Foot, Blue Multicolor
product.description: Enliven your home decor with this lovely Persian-inspired rug. Blue, pale yellow, and white hues create a traditional Persian design that will add interest to any room. A distressed look adds to this rug’s authentic-vintage feel. 5' x 8' Pile: 100% nylon The soft, compact pile of this luxurious rug makes it both beautiful and practical. A handstitched binding gives it a handcrafted, elevated look. The low 0.25" pile makes this rug perfect for medium- to high-traffic areas like bedrooms or living rooms. Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
